title: Wrapper struct IpfsStore impls are pure delegation boilerplate
description: AzureStore, GcsStore, S3Store (transit) and AzureBlockStore, GcsBlockStore, S3BlockStore (reader) each implement IpfsStore/IpfsBlockStore with identical bodies that just forward to self.0.*. This is 3x6=18 delegation methods in this commit alone. A macro (e.g. a delegate! or impl_via_inner! macro) or Deref-based delegation would eliminate the boilerplate. The pattern will grow with each new backend. Suggested rewrite: impl Deref<Target=ObjectStoreBackend> for each wrapper, then a blanket impl IpfsStore for T where T: Deref<Target=ObjectStoreBackend>.
